{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat >> tests/test_journal.py << 'EOF'


def test_generator_input_is_accepted(env):
    db, w = env
    ops = ({'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': i}} for i in range(3))
    assert w.apply(ops) == [1, 2, 3]


def test_non_iterable_input_raises(env):
    db, w = env
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply(42)
    assert db.all() == []


def test_batches_after_rollback_continue_ids(env):
    db, w = env
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}},
                 {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99}])
    assert w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 3}}]) == [2]
    assert [d['x'] for d in db.all()] == [1, 3]


def test_table_handle_identity_preserved(env):
    db, w = env
    handle = db.table('_default')
    db.insert({'x': 1})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99}])
    assert db.table('_default') is handle
    assert len(handle) == 1

python -m pytest -o addopts= tests/test_journal.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3"}
